title: Service Level for Callbacks on Limits and Levels — Personal Sender Account
content:
**Service level.** The limits callback window of a Personal Sender Account is a whole number of Paloma business days, Monday to Friday excluding US Federal Reserve holidays. The limits callback window governs callbacks on limits and levels only.

1. The standard limits callback window is the callback time (in Paloma business days) of the level the account holds on the request date.
2. The counted limits callback window starts from the standard limits callback window.
3. The limits callback window is the counted limits callback window, and never fewer than 1 business day.
4. The due date of a callback on limits and levels is the request date plus the limits callback window, counted forward in Paloma business days from the request date.

The callback time read in point 1 is the callback time set for the level the account holds on the request date.

## Worked example (hypothetical)

An account holds a level whose callback time is 2 Paloma business days, and the customer requests a callback on limits and levels on a Thursday, with no US Federal Reserve holiday in that week or the next. The limits callback window is 2 business days: Friday is day 1 and the following Monday is day 2, so the callback is due by that Monday.

| Callback requested on | Window (business days) | Due date |
|---|---|---|
| Thursday | 2 | the following Monday |
| Monday | 2 | Wednesday of the same week |
| Friday | 1 | the following Monday |
